revision_notes: The cited PDF (2022) discusses only civil-service digitalisation and does not address the ANPE job-seeker registry, as its own comment admits. Benin's official national interoperability catalogue (CatIS/X-Road, checked 2026) lists ANPE's job-seeker system SIC@ (system ID IS00039) as a registered "standard solution" supporting online job-seeker registration, CV creation and employer job-matching (intermediation) — filling the gap the original source flagged as undocumented. This, combined with the Digital Impact Alliance's 2024 confirmation that Benin's exchange links 550+ digitised services across 67 institutions (Benin ranked top in WAEMU on the World Bank's 2025 GovTech Maturity Index), indicates the employment function is operational and catalogued rather than merely "under development." Revised to 4 (Partially integrated); no evidence found of unemployment-insurance or labour-market-information integration, so 5 (Fully Integrated) is not supported.
